note: Synthetic local scheduler benchmark. Use this to validate tuning direction, not universal defaults.

assist_coverage.measured_tier_process_priority: applied to the benchmark process from the selected Focus, Visible Window, or Background tier
assist_coverage.background_efficiency: EcoQoS applied to the preset-selected generated background workers
assist_coverage.affinity: applied as hard affinity for Max Foreground, and for adaptive presets on standard/all-P CPUs to approximate runtime CPU Sets (Soft)
assist_coverage.foreground_priority_boost: applied to the benchmark process when preset enables it
assist_coverage.foreground_thread_priority: applied to the benchmark thread when preset enables it
assist_coverage.foreground_memory_priority: applied to the benchmark process when preset enables it
assist_coverage.foreground_io_priority: applied to the benchmark process when preset enables it; CPU loop has minimal I/O
assist_coverage.foreground_gpu_priority: attempted on the benchmark process when preset enables it; CPU loop may report no GPU context
assist_coverage.background_priority_boost: applied to generated background workers when preset enables it
assist_coverage.thread_priority: applied to existing generated worker threads when preset enables it
assist_coverage.memory_priority: applied to generated background workers when preset enables it
assist_coverage.io_priority: applied to generated background workers when preset enables it; CPU loop has minimal I/O
assist_coverage.gpu_priority: attempted on generated workers when preset enables it; CPU workers may report no GPU context
assist_coverage.process_tier_detection: modeled by treating the benchmark process as the selected tier; the app automation loop is not launched

methodology_gate: Trust a local tuning direction only when median and p95 both improve by at least 3% in at least two of three passes.
